goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

current_best.notes: Iter-12 (30M chars, block 512, tlw 128) landed 1.8869 BPC @ E40 - new best. Data 10M->30M was the big lever (-0.37 BPC vs 10M@block512). Context doubling to 1024 REGRESSED: at 30M chars block1024->1.9812 (iter-13 p9dhom2n), at 10M chars block1024->2.5418 (iter-9 mn2p267h). So 512/stride256 is the converged context budget. Progression: 2.2878 -> 2.2597 (512/10M) -> 1.8869 (512/30M). Next: architecture tweaks on the locked 30M/512 budget.

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers are opaque labels in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-14 (next): LOCK the converging budget at 30M chars / block 512 / stride 256 / tlw 128 / 40 epochs (best=1.8869). Add ARCHITECTURE tweaks from modded-nanogpt: ReLU^2 MLP in chunk+token decoder blocks, logit softcap=15 on the token head. Context 1024 is a proven regression - do not push block_size above 512 without a real efficiency argument.
After ReLU^2+softcap is green at locked budget, try QK-norm + untied embed/head, then Muon optimizer on 2D chunk-decoder weights (Newton-Schulz-5, BF16) with Muon-specific LR ~2-4x AdamW peak.
Consider gated value-skip from compressor output to chunk-decoder output (record-55-style U-net), which compounds with the hierarchical PerPos structure.
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress.
Add a true text8 evaluation path (alternative corpus to cross-validate generalization).
